title: CardCorpus sets with marketplace ids
description: The ids of the sets that have a file in marketplaces/, in order (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#marketplace-ids).

sets.description: The set ids, in the sets' order (sets/{catalog}.json, catalog by catalog).

hashes.description: Each set's marketplace file's hash: the first 16 hex digits of its text's SHA-256, so a reader reloads only the files that changed.
